observed_content: Let source Z[x] degree<=n use falling factorial basis e_k=(x)_k and target integer-valued polynomial lattice use b_k=binom(x,k). D_s e_k=k e_(k-1), D_t b_k=b_(k-1), T e_k=k! b_k. T D_s=D_t T, and T is rationally invertible but integral cokernel direct sum Z/k!Z. Mod p rank=min(p,n+1). This is inclusion of polynomial lattices; not an automorphic theta lift.
